Compliance with Buyer Requirements The bidder shall ensure that all supplied items fully complies with the technical specifications, safety req uirements, and operational requirements mentioned in the bid document. Any deviation shall be clearly in dicated at the time of bidding; otherwise, it shall be deemed that the bidder has accepted all conditions wi thout exception. .
